context: Aoi finally has her baby; cradling with Kenji at the hospital.
purpose: New parents tender first moments with baby.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 産まれた、本当に小さい。
lines.en: She's so tiny. Really, truly small.
lines.style: Soft, reverent whisper. Breath catches slightly on the opening. Wonder and tenderness layered underneath — not performing the moment, living it. Pace slows on 'tiny' like she's committing the detail to memory.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Quiet voice cracking slightly. Kansai warmth but held close, like speaking too loud might break the spell. Small catch in the throat on the second 'cute'. Present and overwhelmed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Look at these fingers — they're so tiny!
lines.style: Gentle delight breaking through. Still soft, but brightness kindling. Slight lift on 'tiny' — wonder returning. Not loud, but warm enough to fill the room without trying.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: You did so well. Really well.
lines.style: Firm and steady underneath the softness. Kansai warmth landing on each word like it matters. A man saying something he means. Slow, deliberate pace. No performance — just acknowledgment and pride.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 幸せって、こういうこと。
lines.style: Quiet realization, not declaration. Certainty underneath the softness. Pause before speaking like she's just understood something. Slight trailing exhale at the end — peace settling in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: From now on, we're a family.
lines.style: Kansai gentleness, grounded and real. Weight on 'family' — not sentimental, but solid. Warmth of someone making a promise without needing to announce it. Steady breath underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Small voice meeting his certainty with her own quiet agreement. Soft but not hesitant. Warmth answering warmth. The feeling of two people choosing the same direction. Slight upward lift on the final word — hopeful, not uncertain.
